title: Reactivating a dormant account

steps.title: Find the dormant account in Customer search
Confirm the dormancy date and the debit block
Post a one dollar test credit
Submit the reactivation for supervisor approval
Send the reactivation confirmation to the customer

decisions: If the ID has expired or the proof of address does not match, do not reactivate and book the customer in for a full KYC refresh; otherwise continue to the test transaction.
warnings: Never use a debit as the test transaction: a debit on a dormant account trips the fraud rule and freezes the account for 72 hours.
openQuestions: Whether dormancy fees are refunded on request: Delphine will confirm the fee refund rule with the Product team.
